articles.title: Nepal to receive first-ever loss and damage fund payout after devastating floods
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Current Affairs: Bilateral Agreements, Foreign Visits & UN/G20/BRICS
articles.keyPoints:
• Nepal is set to receive $21.6 million from the United Nations’ Loss and Damage Fund following the devastating Bhotekoshi floods that struck the country in August.
• The allocation marks the first time the global climate fund has earmarked money for a specific country to address climate-change-linked losses.
• Climate experts have welcomed the decision as a landmark step, but the funding is only a fraction of the nearly $5 billion Nepal estimates it needs for recovery and reconstruction.
